chunks.text: 58-year-old male, Senior Official or Manager, resident of Bukit Batok, Singapore.
Transurethral Resection of the Prostate (TURP) for Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (elective).
General anesthesia for appendectomy in 1985, no complications

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. Today, we'll discuss your upcoming TURP surgery and the anesthesia plan. Can you please share how your prostate issues have been affecting you?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Ah, yes. Been having trouble for about a year now. Weak stream, waking up multiple times at night to pee... it's quite tiring, you know?

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: I see. Let's go through your medications. You're on amlodipine, lisinopril, atorvastatin, metformin, omeprazole, and aspirin. Have you stopped or changed any medications in the past year, especially those related to cardiovascular or antiplatelet therapy?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Oh, the aspirin one. I stopped that six months ago because it kept giving me stomach discomfort, like burning sensation. Doctor said okay to stop since my BP and sugar are controlled.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Thank you for clarifying that. So, your current medications are all still active? Amlodipine, lisinopril, atorvastatin, metformin, and omeprazole?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Yes, all still taking them. No issues with those, just the aspirin was the problem.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Excellent. Any known allergies to medications or other substances?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: None that I know of, doctor.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Great. When was your last meal or drink? We need to ensure you're NPO for surgery.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Had dinner at 8pm last night. Only water after that, stopped at 10pm.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Perfect. Have you had any previous anesthesia or surgeries? Any problems like nausea, breathing issues, or reactions?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No surgeries before this. Never been under GA, so no issues to report.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Understood. Lastly, how's your mobility? Can you walk, climb stairs, or do you need assistance?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I can walk on my own, but sometimes need to rush to the toilet. Stairs are a bit slow, but manageable.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. We'll proceed with general anesthesia and in-line stabilization as planned. You'll be monitored closely for blood pressure and sugar levels during surgery.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Alright, thank you, doctor. Hope everything goes smoothly.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:00] induction propofol one hundred twenty milligrams

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:02] tube in, grade one view

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:05] peripheral IV line placed in left antecubital vein

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:07] arterial line placed in right radial artery

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:10] one thousand milliliters of normal saline administered

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:15] mean arterial pressure dropped to fifty-five mmHg

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:17] phenylephrine twenty micrograms administered

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:20] heart rate increased to eighty-five beats per minute

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: [08:22] labetalol twenty milligrams intravenous bolus

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. How are you feeling now after the surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Morning, Doctor. I'm feeling a bit tired, but otherwise okay lah.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Any pain or discomfort? Let's say on a scale of 1 to 10.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Around 3 or 4. It's manageable, not too bad.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: And how about nausea or breathing issues?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: A bit queasy, but not too bad. Breathing's okay, though my throat's a bit sore.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Do you remember anything from the operation?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nope, everything's a blank. I was out cold.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Given your medical history, any issues with BP, sugar, or reflux?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: BP's stable, sugar checked, all good. No heartburn now.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Alright, we'll keep monitoring. Any other concerns?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, I think that's all. Thanks for checking on me.
